what: Mistake: wrote acceptance criteria that would have failed correct work (job 5b's criterion on 2026-10-17; job 9bw7's criterion 9 forbidding the changelog its own default adds) or allowed the wrong thing (zvmr's criterion 3 allowing interventions after the landing commit); two were caught only by reading the reading.
